title: UTXO’s Duke Waldrop: Bank of Japan “Liquidity Shock” Could Impact Bitcoin
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine UTXO’s Duke Waldrop: Bank of Japan “Liquidity Shock” Could Impact Bitcoin Ahead of Fed and BOJ rate calls, Duke Waldrop explains how yen carry unwinds hit 24/7 Bitcoin liquidity and why Metaplanet trading below NAV is an opportunity. This post UTXO’s Duke Waldrop: Bank of Japan “Liquidity Shock” Could Impact Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
